public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline, and the reviewed records do not establish a decisive event under the early-resolution rule. Anthropic's filing acknowledges financing risks while its IPO remains a proposal. Neither fact settles whether the AI industry will eventually lose access to enough capital. Continuing operations cannot establish indefinite sustainability, and current financial risk is not eventual failure.
limitations: The industry and its prevailing strategy are not precisely defined.
The money claim has no stated accounting basis.
The capital records reviewed cannot establish industry-wide success or failure.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI industry's plans and products are failing and it will run out of capital to keep going indefinitely.

statement.excerpt: As if I haven’t made it clear enough, the AI industry is losing. Their plans are not working, their products are not doing the things that they’ve promised, and though they intend to exhaust every available source of capital, they aren’t going to have enough money to do this forever.

from_speaker: their products are not doing the things that they’ve promised
they aren’t going to have enough money to do this forever
our_interpretation: The forecast's substantive endpoint is that the industry's prevailing development and deployment strategy becomes unable to continue because financing and internally generated funds are insufficient.
The present-tense statements about plans and products are supporting premises, not a deadline.
Forever supplies no finite deadline. No evaluation-date deadline is imposed.
Failure by one firm would not establish failure of the industry.
Continued fundraising would not prove indefinite sustainability, and a financing proposal is not completed financing.
The claim supplies no company perimeter, financial measure, currency, or accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: A decisive industry-wide financing failure forces cessation or abandonment of the prevailing strategy because available external and internally generated funds cannot sustain it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad, durable self-financing operations demonstrate that the claimed dependence on exhaustible outside capital has ended. A finite period of continued operation alone cannot disprove the literal indefinite forecast.

evidence.excerpt: A registration statement relating to these securities has been filed with the SEC but has not yet become effective.
evidence.explanation: The company was pursuing an IPO at the freeze date. Filing does not establish completed funding, sustainable operations, or a decisive result for the industry-wide forecast.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A documented industry-wide financing breakdown that forces the stated strategy to end, or evidence of a durable transition to self-financing across a clearly defined industry. Otherwise the forecast remains open.
